goal: Build one repeatable integrated Runtime proof of a valid first birthday plus a fail-closed not-a-birthday suite.
required_outcome: A real Runtime-produced birthday packet, deterministic validator, retained reviewer index, and typed rejection evidence for every named negative case.
task_boundary: Add the WP-18 demo runner, validator, fixtures, artifacts, and D1-D6 matrix updates without absorbing consumer integration, provider comparison, governance, or publication.
plan_summary: Verify #5825-#5830 and #5832-#5834; bind to landed schemas; implement the positive Runtime harness and negative matrix; run replay, redaction, macOS/Linux, and interruption proof; update D1-D6 only from accepted evidence; then review exact head.
review_scope: Review the WP-18 runner, validator, tests, retained first-birthday packet, negative report, D1-D6 updates, and exact proof paths for real-Runtime provenance, fail-closed behavior, redaction, replay, and scope discipline.
operator_constraints: Temporary preparation binding authorizes card rendering only
Positive proof must come from the integrated Runtime path
No fixture, receipt, cached packet, or synthetic output earns positive credit
Release the preparation claim before handoff

authority_boundary: WP-18 owns the integrated birthday demo and negative suite
#5839 and release-tail issues own governance and publication
initial_assumptions: #5825-#5830 provide birth, identity, continuity, memory, capability, and profile contracts
#5832-#5834 provide ACIP, witness/receipt, and integrated review-packet truth

deliverables: Runtime-produced positive packet and deterministic validator
Not-a-birthday fixture matrix and rejection report
Reviewer index and D1-D6 exact command/artifact updates
non_goals: Legal personhood, consciousness, production citizenship, or public launch

invariants: Every negative case emits a typed rejection
Retained artifacts expose no private state or credentials
D1-D6 status changes only from accepted exact evidence
risks: Dependency schemas may land with different commands
Demo may accidentally validate a fixture
Platform or interruption behavior may be hidden
stop_conditions: No integrated Runtime entrypoint can emit the packet
A required negative cannot be distinguished within issue scope

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: One documented command emits a structurally complete Runtime-produced birthday packet.
AC-2: Startup, wake, restore, snapshot, admission, copied state, simulation, named fixture, and missing-evidence cases reject with typed reasons.
AC-3: Replay, interruption, redaction, and macOS/Linux packet validation pass with allowed nondeterminism declared.
AC-4: D1-D6 and the reviewer index cite exact commands, artifacts, and revisions without publication overclaim.
AC-5: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable finding.

steps.action: Verify all WP-18 dependency revisions, schemas, and commands
Implement the integrated positive runner and deterministic packet validator
Implement and retain the complete not-a-birthday matrix
Run replay, interruption, redaction, platform, and D1-D6 artifact checks
Resolve exact-head review and retain the reviewer index

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove the integrated Runtime emits one complete birthday packet.
Prove all not-a-birthday, interruption, replay, and redaction cases fail closed.
Prove the packet validator and command contract on required macOS/Linux lanes.

review_prompts: Is positive proof emitted by the real integrated Runtime rather than a fixture or lifecycle artifact?
Does every named ordinary lifecycle or missing-evidence case reject with an inspectable reason?
Are replay, interruption, platform, and redaction boundaries proven?
Do D1-D6 and launch-adjacent text avoid unsupported birthday or publication claims?
